Definition: genitive case singular masculine or neuter of G3778; of (from or concerning) this (person or thing):--here(-by), him, it, + such manner of, that, thence(-forth), thereabout, this, thus.
BiblicalUsage: Of this, concerning this — the word that ties a saying to its subject. Jesus says this people's heart is waxed gross, a man shall leave father and mother for this cause, and the shepherds made known abroad the saying told them concerning this child.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word does quiet, necessary work: it fastens the sentence to the person or the cause it is really about.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
